# watchpoint_http_monitor (Resource)

An HTTP/API monitor that checks a URL at a fixed interval with full timing breakdowns (DNS / TCP / TLS / TTFB / transfer).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_http_monitor" "example" {
  name                   = "Production API"
  url                    = "https://api.example.com/health"
  method                 = "GET"
  check_interval_seconds = 60
  timeout_seconds        = 30
  expected_status_codes  = "200"
  expected_body_contains = "\"status\":\"ok\""
  tags                   = ["production", "public-api"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.
- `url` (String) Full URL to check, including scheme.

### Optional

- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `basic_auth_password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Basic auth password. Write-only: the API never returns it, so it is not refreshed on read.
- `basic_auth_user` (String) HTTP Basic auth username.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token sent in the Authorization header. Write-only: the API never returns it, so it is not refreshed on read.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Defaults to `300`. Plans cap the minimum.
- `expected_body_contains` (String) Substring that must appear in the response body for the check to pass.
- `expected_body_regex` (String) Regex the response body must match.
- `expected_header_contains` (String) Substring that must appear in the response headers.
- `expected_response_type_severity` (String) Severity raised on a response-type mismatch. Defaults to `Warning`.
- `expected_response_types` (String) Comma-separated expected response content types.
- `expected_status_codes` (String) Comma-separated acceptable status codes (e.g. `200,201`).
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Follow 3xx redirects. Defaults to `true`.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `is_multi_step` (Boolean) Whether this is a multi-step HTTP pipeline. Defaults to `false`.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check.
- `max_redirects` (Number) Maximum redirects to follow. Defaults to `5`.
- `method` (String) HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS). Defaults to `GET`.
- `request_body` (String) Raw request body sent for POST/PUT/PATCH.
- `request_content_type` (String) Content-Type header for the request body.
- `request_headers` (String) JSON-encoded request headers map.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor for uptime/latency SLO and error-budget tracking. Requires the SLA monitoring feature.
- `steps_json` (String) JSON-encoded step definitions for multi-step HTTP checks.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries (`attributes.tags`). Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls latency thresholds and consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to `30`. Must be < check_interval_seconds.
- `validate_ssl` (Boolean) Verify the TLS certificate. When false, self-signed/expired certs are accepted. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_http_monitor.example mon_abc123
```
